upper: The main z84/z84o curves are absent. L1 gives disconnected pieces: a left part above d0, then a long right part around d+16..+24 that follows a different band region from d0. It does not bridge U3. This is not proof that L1 is the intended sheet or that V5Rc hops sheets.
known: z84/z84o and R1 are near d0 over much of the known ring section; the right edge spreads. CT has neighboring bands and dark cavity, so proximity does not certify a sheet.
judgement: Published lane evidence is usable at the known control but provides no main-pair support on the selected upper rays. Candidate remains unresolved; unavailable support is not a false-ink finding.
